text_block_list.text:
This day has finally arrived. The NHK Mile 
Cup, which crowns the Classic Class Spring 
Mile King.

A race gathering a crowd of over 100,000 
has a completely different atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What is this...? This... reward-tier 
bloodlust radiating from all the Umamusume 
around us...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So sick!! So precious!! And I'm totally 
out of place heeeereee~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter how unworthy I feel, 
the excitement and pounding of my heart 
from actually standing here is... *gasp*!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, my brain is totally fried! A 
festival of Umamusume where dream-like 
talents gather...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Both the beauty and terror are in such 
vivid high definition that I can barely 
keep standing...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, I must ascertain it. I cannot 
resist the urge to find out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The deepest depths of Umamusume-chan's 
preciousness! Where on earth does that 
radiance originate from!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even if I end up being purified by that 
divine aura...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Was someone looking at me just now? I felt 
this weird tickling sensation at my 
sides...
choice_data_list:
No one's staring at me or anything, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I see. Of all things, for me to dream 
about being an idol among idols...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oops, no time to get carried away!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I must uncover the secret 
of the Umamusume's preciousness with my 
very own body!

For a major race like this, the 
competition is beyond reproach. Let's see 
you showcase your talent as an all-rounder 
while learning from top-tier Umamusume.
